chemistry-killer-01.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
E mere nnwale iji mepụta copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$) site n'ime ka ntụ ọla kọpa (Cu) meghachi omume na oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) n'ime arịa mechiri emechi. N'ime nnwale niile, $\mathrm{O_2}$ dị n'ime arịa bụ 2.0 g, ma mmeghachi omume bụ $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Oke CuO a mepụtara mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị bụ nke a:
(A) Cu 4.0 g → CuO 5.0 g
(B) Cu 8.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
(C) Cu 12.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
Mgbe iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro dị n'otu ọnọdụ, kedu nsonaazụ ziri ezi mgbe Cu 14.0 g na $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g n'ime otu arịa na-emeghachi omume ruo mgbe otu reactant gwụrụ kpamkpam?

Nzọụkwụ 1: (C), ebe CuO anaghị abawanye karịa 10.0 g ọbụlagodi mgbe Cu na-abawanye, bụ ọnọdụ ebe $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2.0 g dị n'arịa meghachiri kpamkpam, ya mere CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g, ya bụ Cu:O = 4:1 (nyocha: (A) bụ Cu 4.0 g + O 1.0 g = 5.0 g, O fọdụrụ, (B) bụ Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g = 10.0 g, enweghị ọtụtụ ma ọ bụ ntakịrị, ma (C) Cu 4.0 g fọdụrụ).
Nzọụkwụ 2: Oke O na-emeghachi omume kpamkpam na Cu 14.0 g = $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g. Ebe $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g e nyere karịrị nke a, Cu niile na-emeghachi omume ma $\mathrm{O_2}$ $4.0-3.5=0.5$ g fọdụrụ.
Nzọụkwụ 3: CuO a mepụtara = 14.0 + 3.5 = 17.5 g (nchekwa oke, oke Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Ya mere azịza ziri ezi bụ a: CuO 17.5 g a mepụtara, $\mathrm{O_2}$ 0.5 g fọdụrụ. (Azịza ezighi ezi: ngụkọta oke 18.0 g gụnyere O na-emeghachighị omume, 20.0 g gbadoro ụkwụ na O 4.0 g ma leghara anya na ezughị nke Cu)
